inputs.text: [excited] He was 4 meters long — like a small car! [amazed] He was as tall as a 4-year-old! And he weighed as heavy as a small car — [serious] the size AND the weight of one, all in one animal!
[playful] A car that weighs a car?
[chuckles] Exactly — the size [confident] and the weight of a small car, all wrapped up in one.
